description.zh: 镜像ID。如何获取镜像ID，请参见[ListImages](~~449118~~)  。
description.en: The image ID. For more information about how to obtain an image ID, see [ListImages](~~449118~~).

description.zh:
标签过滤条件，多个条件以逗号分隔。
单个条件过滤格式为`key=value`。
与LabelKeys分别独立生效。
description.en:
The filter conditions for labels. Separate multiple conditions with commas.
The format for a single condition is `key=value`.
This parameter works independently of the LabelKeys parameter.

description.zh:
标签键的列表，以半角逗号（,）分隔。
系统标签以system开头，与LabelFilter分别独立生效。
description.en:
The list of tag keys. Separate multiple keys with commas (,).
System tags start with "system". This parameter works independently of the LabelFilter parameter.
The region where the image resides.

description.zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见[ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~)。
description.en: The workspace ID. For more information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun aiworkspace list-image-labels --label-keys system.framework,system.official --label-filter system.framework=XGBoost_1.6.0,system.official=true --image-id image-4c6200000053uor --workspace-id 12345 --biz-region cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
